description: Create a quiz when the user asks for a quiz or to be tested without naming a format. Shows a selector where the user picks the format: multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank, match pairs, ranking, crossword or flashcards.

ai_chat_context.description: Short summary of the points from this chat the user wants covered, not a transcript

ai_research.description: AI-generated research content based on the topic - the more comprehensive, the better the output

auto_research.description: Auto-generate research content if no sources provided. Defaults to true when only title is given (no sources), false otherwise. Set explicitly to false to require manual sources.

course_id.description: Course ID for unit completion tracking (optional - passed from course-syllabus widget)

notes.description: Text notes to include in content

title.description: Title for standalone content generation (required when using sources)

unit_id.description: Unit ID to generate content for (optional - use this OR provide sources)

webpage_url.description: Webpage URL to extract content from

youtube_link.description: YouTube video URL as content source (video will be processed for learning content)
